stevin1586.title: De Beghinselen des Waterwichts
stevin1586.container: Leiden: printed at the office of Christoffel Plantijn by Françoys van Raphelinghen
stevin1586.note: The first systematic treatise on hydrostatics since Archimedes; Proposition X states the hydrostatic paradox. An English translation is in volume I of The Principal Works of Simon Stevin, ed. E.J. Dijksterhuis (Amsterdam: Swets & Zeitlinger, 1955).

minnaert1976.title: Stevin, Simon
minnaert1976.container: In C.C. Gillispie (ed.), Dictionary of Scientific Biography, vol. 13. New York: Charles Scribner's Sons. The entry begins on p. 47
minnaert1976.note: Says Stevin explained the hydrostatic paradox by imagining parts of the water to be solidified.

usstd1976.note: Sea level: pressure 101,325 Pa, density 1.225 kg/m³.

imss-vacuum.title: Horror vacui? The syphon experiment
imss-vacuum.note: Galileo's account of the limit of about 18 braccia (around 11 m) to which a pump could raise water.
